goal: Rebuild messaging for A+ Study House Android app using Node.js + Socket.io, replacing all Supabase REST messaging code with real-time socket communication while preserving existing Supabase auth, profiles, and data.
reference: Parent and admin can send messages from their respective Messages chat UIs and see each other's messages instantly. Server must persist messages to Supabase messages table. Evidence: message appears on both sides within 2s, Android app connects to Node server over socket, AUDIT logs show socket events.

pieces.name: Scaffold Node.js + Socket.io server
pieces.description: Create server/ directory with package.json, install dependencies, implement basic server that starts without errors.
pieces.quality_gate: Inspector can run `node server/index.js` and see server start on configured port without crashing.

pieces.name: Implement Socket.io messaging handlers
pieces.description: Add JWT auth middleware, user rooms, send_message handler with Supabase persistence, load_history handler, and new_message broadcast.
pieces.quality_gate: Inspector can connect with a test client, emit send_message, see row inserted in Supabase messages table, and receive new_message event.

pieces.name: Add Socket.io client to Android app
pieces.description: Add io.socket:socket.io-client dependency, create SupabaseSocketRepository.kt singleton for connection management, send, load_history, and message listener.
pieces.quality_gate: Inspector can open SupabaseSocketRepository.kt and see connect(), sendMessage(), loadHistory(), and onNewMessage callback/socket listener.

pieces.name: Wire parent chat to Socket.io
pieces.description: Replace REST calls in ParentMessagesScreen.kt with socket emit/listen, keep WhatsApp UI and optimistic bubbles, remove debug UI.
pieces.quality_gate: Inspector can run the app, open parent chat, send a message, and see it appear as a bubble. Server logs show send_message event.

pieces.name: Wire admin chat to Socket.io
pieces.description: Replace REST calls in AdminMessagesScreen.kt with socket emit/listen, keep WhatsApp UI and optimistic bubbles.
pieces.quality_gate: Inspector can run the app, open admin parent chat, send a message, and see it appear as a bubble. Parent receives it via socket.

pieces.name: Remove old REST messaging code
pieces.description: Delete or deprecate sendMessage, getConversation, getConversationRaw, findAdminIdFromMessages from SupabaseRepository.kt. Remove dead imports and AUDIT cruft.
pieces.quality_gate: Inspector can grep for getConversation( and findAdminIdFromMessages( in the app source and find zero matches.

pieces.name: End-to-end socket messaging test
pieces.description: Test parent sends, admin receives; admin sends, parent receives; history loads on both sides; offline message handling.
pieces.quality_gate: Inspector can perform the manual test steps and confirm both sides see sent and received messages within 2 seconds.
